|{4:** }{5:*}{6:bold}{5:*}{4: two}|
|{7:*** }{8:*}{9:bold}{8:*}{7: three}|
|{10:**** }{11:/}{12:italic}{11:/}{10: and }{13:*}{14:bold}{13:*}{10: four}|
|{15:***** }{16:_}{17:under}{16:_}{15: }{18:=}{19:verbatim}{18:=}{15: }{20:~}{21:code}{20:~}{15: }{22:+}{23:strike}{22:+}{15: five}|
|Body with {24:*}{25:bold}{24:*}, {26:/}{27:italic}{26:/} and {28:=}{29:verbatim}{28:=}.|

{1} OrgHeadlineLevel1 -> Title [bold]
{2} OrgHeadlineLevel1 -> Title | orgBoldDelimiter -> OrgBold [bold]
{3} OrgHeadlineLevel1 -> Title | OrgBold [bold]
{4} OrgHeadlineLevel2 -> Constant
{5} OrgHeadlineLevel2 -> Constant | orgBoldDelimiter -> OrgBold [bold]
{6} OrgHeadlineLevel2 -> Constant | OrgBold [bold]
{7} OrgHeadlineLevel3 -> Identifier
{8} OrgHeadlineLevel3 -> Identifier | orgBoldDelimiter -> OrgBold [bold]
{9} OrgHeadlineLevel3 -> Identifier | OrgBold [bold]
{10} OrgHeadlineLevel4 -> Statement [bold]
{11} OrgHeadlineLevel4 -> Statement | orgItalicDelimiter -> OrgItalic [bold, italic]
{12} OrgHeadlineLevel4 -> Statement | OrgItalic [bold, italic]
{13} OrgHeadlineLevel4 -> Statement | orgBoldDelimiter -> OrgBold [bold]
{14} OrgHeadlineLevel4 -> Statement | OrgBold [bold]
{15} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc
{16} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc | orgUnderlineDelimiter -> OrgUnderline [underline]
{17} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc | OrgUnderline [underline]
{18} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc | orgVerbatimDelimiter -> OrgVerbatim -> String
{19} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc | OrgVerbatim -> String
{20} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc | orgCodeDelimiter -> OrgCode -> String
{21} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc | OrgCode -> String
{22} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc | orgStrikethroughDelimiter -> OrgStrikethrough [strikethrough]
{23} OrgHeadlineLevel5 -> PreProc | OrgStrikethrough [strikethrough]
{24} orgBoldDelimiter -> OrgBold [bold]
{25} OrgBold [bold]
{26} orgItalicDelimiter -> OrgItalic [italic]
{27} OrgItalic [italic]
{28} orgVerbatimDelimiter -> OrgVerbatim -> String
{29} OrgVerbatim -> String
